title: Mathlib v4.30 source proposition Nat.gcd_mul_lcm
statement: The proposition declared as `Nat.gcd_mul_lcm` in the pinned Mathlib v4.30 source.

formal.statement: ∀ (m n : ℕ), m.gcd n * m.lcm n = m * n

evidence.notes: `build_nat_prelude` admits `Nat.gcd_mul_lcm` through the trusted `Kernel::add_declaration` gate (declared in `nat_prelude/lcm.rs`'s `declare_gcd_mul_lcm`, landed before this session).
